description: The same three-times-baseline candle as the absorption case, one dollar short of the absolute quote floor. SPIKE by class, and no spike by §6.2.
labelling_rationale: This series is the deliberate twin of s7-volume-spike-on-a-doji-is-absorption: identical in every field except quote_volume, which is 249999 rather than 300000. §6.1 still bands it SPIKE — RVOL is exactly 3.0 against a filler median of 100, and the classification is a per-candle measurement that knows nothing about turnover. §6.2 is the gate that refuses it: it requires the SPIKE-or-ABNORMAL class AND quote-volume at or above P.volume.spike_floor = 250000, and the floor exists for exactly this reason, stated in the spec itself — an absolute floor 'prevents micro-cap spikes of $8k from scoring'. One dollar below is chosen rather than a comfortable margin because the boundary is what this case asserts: 250000 confirms and 249999 does not, so an implementation that read the comparison as strictly-greater would pass the sibling case and fail this one. Everything else is held identical so the difference cannot be attributed elsewhere: same H4 timeframe (avoiding §2.11's time-of-day baseline, which no hand-written series can supply), same doji body so §7.2's acceleration cannot fire, same two flat candles before it so §6.3's expansion test cannot see three rising volumes.
